display_name: Crisis 2028: GIUK Gap & Arctic Bastion Under-Ice ASW Duel
briefing_opord: OPORD 28-104: OPFOR Northern Fleet SSBNs (Borei and Yasen-M) sortie into the Greenland-Iceland-UK (GIUK) Gap beneath polar pack ice to establish second-strike launch points. NATO activates the SOSUS hydrophone acoustic barrier. US Navy SSN-688(I) Cheyenne and Virginia-class attack submarines, supported by P-8A Poseidon ASW flights and Orca XLUUV autonomous subs, engage in a silent cat-and-mouse duel to defend the North Atlantic sea lanes.
key_features: P-8A Poseidon Sonobuoy Fields & ASW Torpedo Drops
